scripts.deploy: git push origin main && git push origin --tags
scripts.firmware:uart_echo: mkdir -p firmware/uart_echo && cp examples/uart_echo/*.c firmware/uart_echo/ && pio run -e uart_echo
scripts.package:ubuntu: mkdir -p dist && VERSION=${npm_package_version} nfpm package -f packaging/nfpm.yaml --packager deb --target dist/protosim_${npm_package_version}_amd64.deb
scripts.package:fedora: mkdir -p dist && VERSION=${npm_package_version} nfpm package -f packaging/nfpm.yaml --packager rpm --target dist/protosim-${npm_package_version}.x86_64.rpm
scripts.package:arch: mkdir -p dist && VERSION=${npm_package_version} nfpm package -f packaging/nfpm.yaml --packager archlinux --target dist/protosim-${npm_package_version}-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst
scripts.package: npm run package:ubuntu && npm run package:fedora && npm run package:arch
